"Edy history record layout for service `170F` (sent to the tag as bytes `17 0F`). Byte `0` is transaction type, byte `1` unknown, `2-3` transaction number (BE), `4-7` packed date/time (BE: 15-bit elapsed days since 2000-01-01 plus 17-bit seconds since midnight), `8-11` amount (BE), and `12-15` balance after (BE)."
"Edy history records store type, sequence, packed elapsed date/time, amount, and balance in a 16-byte block."
"Exchange rate: 1 Hong Kong dollar equals %@ Chinese yuan."

"FeliCa gate activity record layout for service `108F` (`8F10` little-endian on card I/O). Bytes `0-1` are activity/subtype, `2-3` station code, `4-5` device number, `6-7` packed date, `8-9` BCD time, `10-11` amount, `12-13` pass-boundary fare, and `14-15` pass-boundary station."

"Upload technical trip records from eligible Korean cards such as T-money and EZL/Cashbee to help analyze South Korea trip record formats. Uploaded data includes a deduplication hash, a hashed card ID, the last 4 characters of the card ID, bytes 0x05-0x08, bytes 0x09-0x0A, and the full raw record bytes. This uses HTTPS and can be turned off or on at any time in Settings."
"Use online enquiry to save the card number and balance offset. Saved information remains available offline."
"Versioned card-specific record; unverified identifiers are not station locations."
"WAON history comes from service 680B. Each record is two 16-byte blocks; bytes 18-28 are MSB-first packed fields."

"WAON history record layout for service `680B` (`0B68` little-endian on card I/O). Bytes `0-12` are the terminal number, `13-14` are the record number, byte `17` is the transaction type, and bytes `18-28` contain MSB-first packed date, balance, usage amount, and charge amount fields."
"When enabled, KS X 6924 scans probe all SFIs with read-only APDUs and preserve every readable record and short-EF binary block in Raw Data. Scans take longer."

"When enabled, eligible T-money and EZL/Cashbee scans upload technical trip records for format analysis. Uploaded fields are a dedup hash of card ID plus raw bytes, a hashed card ID, the last 4 characters of the card ID, bytes 0x05-0x08, bytes 0x09-0x0A, and the full raw bytes. Uploads use HTTPS and you can disable this at any time."

"nanaco history record layout for service `564F` (`4F56` little-endian on card I/O). Byte `0` is the transaction type, bytes `1-4` the amount (BE), `5-8` the balance after (BE), `9-12` the packed date/time (BE), `13-14` the transaction number (BE), and `15` is reserved."
"nanaco history service 564F stores transaction type, amount, balance, packed date/time, and sequence."
